title: Chapter 630
text:
The shockwaves from the collision of the seven Calamity Grade Supers were earth-shattering!

The shockwave destroyed half of the base, and the surrounding streets were in shambles. Many players were blown away. They were currently at level 90, so they were of little use in a battle of this level. Just the aftermath of the AOE attack had taken away a small amount of their HP. Helpless, they could only play a supporting role. Was this the world of the strong?

Rumble —

With seven Calamity Grade Supers fighting, even though Han Xiao, Nagakin, and the others had controlled their power, the destruction was still not small. Although the base was heavily damaged, Han Xiao did not feel the pinch. Only the buildings on the surface were damaged, and rebuilding them was very cheap. Furthermore, he had already reached the level of 'I am not interested in money'. In order to lure the three of them, he did not care about this small price.

This was the second time he had fought with Shana. Han Xiao had built a group of mechanical soldiers made of non-metallic materials, mainly elites. With the boost of his Mechanical Force, they were extremely powerful. Shana could not restrain him and could only fight him head-on.

Eliot and Adrian were the main force. Eliot was a powerful magician, casting all kinds of high-level spells as if they were free. The magical radiance was colorful and dazzling, and he seemed to be at ease. Adrian, on the other hand, was a typical brawny guy, acting as a meat shield. He single-handedly entangled Nagakin and the other two Pugilists, grinding their bodies against each other.

The three of them worked well together. Nagojin and the others were beaten to a pulp, and Han Xiao was controlling the mechanical soldiers to attack 'with all his might'. It seemed like he was on par with Shana.

Nagojin and his two colleagues were all Pugilists. In terms of raw strength, they were far weaker than the three of them. Adrian alone could hold back the three of them, and they were instantly at a disadvantage. However, Eliot and the others were not in the mood to fight. They retreated as they fought, and the battlefield quickly changed.

Black Star had an ambush, so they could not end the battle quickly. This was the colonial planet of Godora, and there was a fleet stationed there. Eliot and the others did not want to be surrounded by the garrison, so they were prepared to retreat as soon as possible. They were very confident about this.

Because Eliot knew teleportation spells, he was an expert at escaping. Black Star wanted to catch them, but it was destined to be a dream. Therefore, Eliot found it very funny. He didn't know where Black Star's confidence came from.

Hu hu — —

At this moment, the sound of spaceships could be heard from the horizon. A garrison fleet quickly responded, and over a hundred battleships were rushing over to provide support.

"There is no need to fight with Godora's fleet. Let's go."

Eliot had Adrian block Nagojin and the other two. Then, he chanted an incantation. With a swipe of his finger, an energy vortex appeared behind him and expanded into a portal.

"Oh no, he can teleport!" Nagojin put on an exaggerated expression of shock. Han Xiao glanced at him and couldn't help but praise his acting skills. His expression was vivid and his eyes were exquisite. His acting skills were also at the A-level.

Eliot switched to another spell. A huge magic barrier separated all the enemies, protecting himself and his two companions.

The magic barrier blocked all the attacks and vibrated non-stop. Adrian and Shana entered the portal and disappeared.

After the two companions left, Eliot looked at Han Xiao and joked, "Hehe, I told you, you are too confident. You can't catch us with an ambush of this level. If we want to leave, can you stop us?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's face darkened. He purposely did not say a word and increased the power of his attacks. The attacks hit the magic barrier and made loud banging sounds. It was as if it was real.

In Eliot's eyes, Black Star's behavior was obviously because he was angry. He instantly felt better, and the depression from the failure of the mission disappeared.

Eliot narrowed his eyes and suddenly said with evil intentions, "Just wait.

We will come for you again. You can't always have someone to help you. "

After that, Eliot turned and walked into the portal. Then, the portal disappeared, and the three of them successfully escaped. They could come and go as they pleased.

Finally chased them away … Only then did Han Xiao relax his tense facial muscles and release his anger.

"JPG" emoji.

Although the battle was short, the surrounding streets had been severely damaged. The strength of the enemy made Nagojin feel great pressure.

"Phew … Black Star, where did these people come from? They are too strong. They have their eyes on you. You have to be careful."

Nagojin said seriously.

"Don't worry, they can't run away."

Next, I just have to wait for them to go home … Han Xiao did not finish his sentence and smiled.

There was an extra reward from this battle. He exposed Eliot's teleportation spell. This was a godly escape skill. If he was not mentally prepared, he might have let the enemy escape when attacking the base. Now that he had information, he could think of a way to deal with it.

Thinking about how Eliot and the other two thought that they had successfully escaped, Han Xiao almost wanted to laugh out loud.

This was not a loss, it was a gain!

After contacting the engineering team to repair the base and sending away a large group of players who wanted to try to trigger the mission, Han Xiao used the Observer's Mark to spy on the three's movements.

…

The teleportation portal that Eliot used in a hurry could not be too far away. The portal connected the three's spaceship, which was parked outside the Colonial Planet.

As soon as they returned to the spaceship, the three started the spaceship and left the Colonial Planet. They activated the stealth mode to prevent being chased by the garrison fleet.

The escape was successful. The three did not suspect that Han Xiao wanted to let them go at all. They retreated with Eliot's ability, and there was nothing suspicious about it. They just thought that Black Star had underestimated their strength and did not have enough strength to ambush them.

Black Star's ambush had failed. The three did not take it to heart, thinking that it was normal.

"This operation has failed. Should we continue to look for opportunities?" Shana asked.

"Black Star is very vigilant. When he encountered the first attack, he set up a trap just because he was suspicious. Now that he encountered the second attack, he is sure that we are his enemies. He will only be more vigilant. We can't attack him in the short term."

Eliot shook his head. After this incident, he could only ignore Black Star.

He had purposely threatened before leaving, but it was just a feint. He wanted to make Black Star be wary of them, be careful, and be afraid. In the end, he realized that it was a waste of effort. Eliot just wanted to make a fool out of Han Xiao.

Shana frowned, looking irritated. "That's all we can do."

"Okay, I will suggest to Albert to put Black Star on the deferred list," Eliot said.

In fact, they had two hunting lists. One was the pending targets, and the other was the delayed list. The latter was the targets that they had failed to capture for the first time. They would not make a move on these people in the short term. It would take at least a few years for the targets to relax before they would make a move again.

Black Star had become such a target. Eliot did not want to attack Black Star in the next five years, and he believed that Albert had the same idea.

"You were right. We should have dealt with this matter long ago." Shana snorted. She did not expect Black Star to be so cautious.

"It's not too late now. Although we've exposed our hostility and let Black Star know that the three of us have our eyes on him, he knows nothing about our origins. No matter how he investigates, it'll be futile. At most, we'll have to lay low for a period of time. He's destined to get nothing. He won't know who's targeting him."

Eliot smiled. "But we are hiding in the dark and have the initiative. He can't be careful forever."

"Let's go back first. We will probably have to stop moving for the next few years."

…

Many people witnessed the attack on Black Star, and the news spread.

However, there were all kinds of news in the Shattered Star Ring every day. Although Black Star was quite famous in the Colton Star Cluster, in the entire Shattered Star Ring, this little bit of fame was not enough. The news of him being attacked was like a drop of water in the ocean, inconspicuous and did not attract many people's attention.

More than ten days later, Han Xiao rushed to an uninhabited planet near the desolate universe belt. This planet that had been desolate for countless years was now extremely lively.

All the organizations that he had contacted before were gathered there, and spaceships were parked all over the place.

These organizations all wanted to find their missing experts, so they followed Han Xiao's request and came to this planet. They originally thought that they were alone, but when they arrived, they were all shocked. They did not expect Han Xiao to call so many people.

Many of the organizations there were famous in the Shattered Star Ring and recognized each other. After a short conversation, they all knew that everyone was there for the same reason. They were all shocked. Could the missing experts of all their organizations be related? What clues did Han Xiao find?

As soon as the spaceship approached, it was noticed by everyone. After Han Xiao landed, everyone surrounded him.

These people were all high-level officers of the organizations. If they were outside, they would all be big shots. Ordinary people would not even be able to see them, but now, they were all gathered together. If Heber was there, he might have thought that someone was copying his Tyrant Party.

"Black Star, when are we moving?"

"Where is the enemy? Don't hide it anymore."

When Han Xiao contacted them, he did not tell them all the information and only told them to wait for orders. Many people were dissatisfied with this.

However, Ames was there too. Black Star was an officer of the Dragon Emperor. Although everyone present had a strong background, they did not dare to be rash.

"The time has come. Let's attack the enemy's headquarters together. Your missing companions are imprisoned there …"

Han Xiao explained. Through the Observer's Mark, he confirmed that Shana and the other two had returned to the headquarters. The chance to catch them all had finally come.

Things were different now. He had fought with the Germinal Organization's Dark-star for many years, but that was because he was not strong enough.

Now, the Black Star Corps was gradually rising, and he had become the number one person in the Shattered Star Ring. The difference in their strength was like heaven and earth. He was not willing to be enemies with a group of strong enemies for a long time. Once he had the chance, he would kill them immediately and not leave any threats behind.

With so many organizations sending their elite troops, their combined strength was enough to shock any civilization or organization in the Shattered Star Ring. Just the Calamity Grade Supers leading the team numbered in the dozens, and they came from different regions. Dealing with six enemies was like bullying.

Han Technician's networking ability was unparalleled. His network was not just for show!

Everyone was overjoyed. For the same goal, these organizations were all willing to listen to Han Xiao for the time being.

While Han Xiao was negotiating with them, the players he had brought with him were curiously observing from the back.

He used missions to get some players to follow him. This time, he did not need them to fight. Han Xiao only needed them to act as' reporters' and post videos on the forums. This was where he planned to leave a good impression. He wanted the players to see his charisma and increase his personal charisma and faction charisma.

…

At the same time, Eliot and the other two returned to the secret base in the desolate universe belt.

Albert welcomed the three of them and said, "I already know the situation. Don't worry about Black Star. We will keep a low profile for a period of time. Everyone will stay in the base and not go out."

Everyone nodded. This method could effectively avoid risks. They would lie low for a period of time before starting the hunting mission again.

They directly threw the problem with Black Star to the back of their minds. This matter had already come to an end in their eyes.
